text:
Done. 10/10 tests pass.

**Files:**
- `app.py` — Flask app factory, SQLite storage
- `test_app.py` — pytest suite

**API:**
| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/shorten` | `{"url": "...", "code": "optional"}` → 201 with short code |
| GET | `/<code>` | 302 redirect, increments hit counter |
| GET | `/api/urls/<code>` | Stats (url, hits) |
| DELETE | `/api/urls/<code>` | Remove link |

**Notes:** validates http/https URLs, 7-char random codes via `secrets`, optional custom codes (409 on conflict), 400/404 error handling. Run with `python app.py`, test with `pytest`.
